questions.quote: The term 'economic development' refers to the overall growth of all sectors of the economy by adoption of new technologies. Economic development improves the living standards of the people as well as the status of the country.

options: the overall growth of all sectors of the economy by adoption of new technologies
en.explanation: Development refers to improvement in quality of life such as higher income, better education and health, less poverty and more equal opportunity.
